questions.stem_text: Which of the following is not a feature of globalization?

options.A: an increasing awareness of the world as a whole
options.B: the extended power of nation states
options.C: the destruction of distance through communications technologies
options.D: the stretching of social relations beyond national boundaries

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - the extended power of nation states

questions.stem_text: The terms 'crisis of the 1970 s' is used to refer to:

options.B: the eradication of the welfare state
options.C: rising divorce rates and the decline of the traditional family
options.D: an unfortunate twist in fashion sensibility

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - declining profits and rising unemployment

questions.stem_text: The Nation of Islam group appealed to:

options.A: British-born second generation immigrants from the Asian subcontinent
options.B: White Americans who wanted to convert to Islam
options.C: African-Americans who felt excluded from the 'ethnic melting pot' in the USA
options.D: African-Caribbeans who lived in the inner cities and had a distinctive youth culture

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - African-Americans who felt excluded from the 'ethnic melting pot' in the USA
